name: ruwritingstyles-obsidian
description: Obsidian plugin for RuWritingStyles deterministic philological checks (IAST transliteration + journal compliance).
author: M. Yu. Gasuns
comment:codemirror: obsidian 1.13.1 pins its @codemirror/* peers to EXACT versions (state 6.5.0, view 6.38.6). @codemirror/lint is pinned to 6.9.0 because 6.9.1+ require @codemirror/view ^6.42.0, which conflicts with obsidian's 6.38.6 peer. The overrides below force a single copy of state/view across the whole tree so lint cannot nest a second (newer) copy, which otherwise yields duplicate-type errors in tsc. When bumping obsidian, re-read its peerDependencies and keep all three @codemirror/* in lockstep (and re-check the max lint version whose view range still admits the new view).
